arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Olson argued no property tax has violated the Tonnage Clause.
Mr. Rothfeld responded to the Court's questions about the tax.
Justice Souter questioned whether other vessels face similar taxes.
Justice Scalia warned that a fragile judgment might result.
